passage:
schedule — 时间表，日程安排
Her work schedule changes every week.

shifts — 轮班，班次
Some weeks she works early shifts, and some weeks she works late shifts.

recipes — 食谱，烹饪方法
She has a few recipes for quick meals.

snacks — 零食，小吃
She should not buy too many snacks because she eats them too quickly.

fridge — 冰箱
She has a little milk in the fridge, so she can make a healthy breakfast.

nuts — 坚果
On busy days, she takes an apple and some nuts to work.

breaks — 休息时间
She does not have many breaks, so she eats quickly.

prepare — 准备
Lin's friend, Mei, asks her, "How much time do you have for lunch?" Lin says, "Only a little time, about twenty minutes." Mei says, "You should prepare your lunch the night before.
